label: IGH / BCL6
tumor_contexts: B-cell lymphoma, including diffuse large B-cell lymphoma

sections.text: IGH is the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus, with potent B-lineage regulatory elements.
BCL6 encodes a transcriptional repressor required for germinal-center B-cell programs.

The rearrangement substitutes immunoglobulin regulatory elements for normal BCL6 control, sustaining BCL6-dependent transcriptional repression. BCL6 rearrangements occur in several B-cell lymphomas and are not specific to one histologic type.
